theme: Leaders now — PM, President, Haryana CM (refresh)

questions.question: Who is the Prime Minister of India (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: The Prime Minister is the leader of the party that wins the most seats in the Lok Sabha elections.

questions.question: Who is the President of India (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: Droupadi Murmu became President in 2022 and is the second woman to hold the post.

questions.question: Who is the Chief Minister of Haryana (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: As Chief Minister, Nayab Singh Saini leads the government of our home state, Haryana.

questions.question: Who became the Vice President of India in 2025?
questions.funFact: The Vice President is the second-highest office in India, right after the President.

questions.question: Droupadi Murmu is the first President of India from a tribal community.
questions.funFact: Before becoming President, Droupadi Murmu had also served as the Governor of the state of Jharkhand.

questions.question: The President of India lives in a grand building in New Delhi called ___ Bhavan.
questions.funFact: 'Rashtrapati' is the Hindi word for President, so Rashtrapati Bhavan means the President's House.

questions.question: Who is the Chief Justice of India, the head of the courts (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: The Chief Justice leads the Supreme Court, which is the highest court in all of India.

questions.question: Narendra Modi became Prime Minister of India for the third time in 2024.
questions.funFact: He first became Prime Minister in 2014, and again in 2019 and 2024.

questions.question: Which leader looks after India's money and budget as the Finance Minister (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: The Finance Minister presents the country's Budget in Parliament, usually on the 1st of February each year.

questions.question: A state is led by a Chief Minister, while the whole country is led by the Prime ___.
questions.funFact: India has one Prime Minister for the country and a separate Chief Minister for each state.

questions.question: The Home Minister of India (as of 2026) is ___.
questions.funFact: The Home Minister looks after the safety and internal peace of the whole country.

questions.question: The Prime Minister leads the central government that runs the whole country.
questions.funFact: The Prime Minister works with a team of ministers, each in charge of a different area like defence or education.
